SCH-004 Minor JSON-SQL-DRIFT crates/raptor-schema/src/schema.rs:394
Criterion: plan requires accept to treat an absent key where null is the meaning as an error; unspecified whether published schema must express it.
Evidence: top-level rows use serde flatten, no additionalProperties:false; Option fields omitted from `required` (boundary.rs:108-113 asserts supersedes absent; same for superseded_by, IdItem.note, LinkItem.note, CheckItem.checked) while accept returns MissingKey (tests/schema/boundary.rs:114-127; accept.rs:118-120). Operator ruling: is accept() the sole strictness authority.

findings.original_finding:
SCH-005 Important JSON-SQL-DRIFT crates/raptor-schema/src/accept.rs:351 (from coordinator probe /tmp/raptor-schema-root-kind-probe.json)
Criteria: (1) phase-b-plan.md:46 RecordKind REQ/NFR/ADR "read from the id, selects the table"; (2) sprint-b-1:111-114 DDL CHECK on id for the table's prefixes; (3) sprint-b-6:158-166 accept() only way a record enters, a Batch proves every record passed accept; (4) JSON Schema, SQL and Python metadata agree with Rust authority.
Evidence: requirement row with id ADR-CHECK-9999 is admitted by accept() (only 2 unrelated DanglingReference errors); generated requirements DDL rejects it (CHECK substr(id,1,4) IN ('REQ-','NFR-')). record_kinds(TableId) (schema.rs:209-214) is used only by emission (emit.rs:196,259; boundary.rs:81,85), never ingress (accept.rs:136-150, 246-294, 351-394). Id::try_from accepts any of REQ/NFR/ADR.
Required: accept() rejects with structured Error an id whose RecordKind is outside record_kinds(table), at /id, both tables; Rust test per table; test tying ingress to SQL CHECK. Error category by operator ruling if none fits. No gate relaxation.
findings.original_acceptance_criterion: accept() rejects with structured Error an id whose RecordKind is outside record_kinds(table), at /id, both tables; Rust test per table; test tying ingress to SQL CHECK. Error category by operator ruling if none fits. No gate relaxation.
